arxiv-2102-11725.title: What are discrete valuation rings? What are Dedekind domains? Thanks: Version of August 9, 2026.
arxiv-2102-11725.creator: A Mathematical Essay by Wayne Aitken, A mathematical essay by Wayne Aitken
arxiv-2102-11725.description: Abstract \midsloppy \settypeblocksize 47360pt* \setulmargins 1.5in** \setlrmargins **1 \setheadfoot \onelineskip 2 \onelineskip \setheaderspaces *1.5 \onelineskip * \checkandfixthelayout This essay introduces discrete valuation rings (DVRs), and shows that they have several possible definitions that are equivalent (we call these “characterizations”). We will use discrete valuations and other ideas to see that Dedekind domains have several interesting equivalent characterizations as well.

arxiv-2107-05970.title: Spatiotemporal refraction of light in an epsilon-near-zero ITO layer Journal: osajournal Publication type: Research Letter
arxiv-2107-05970.creator: Justus Bohn \authormark 1,*, Ting Shan Luk \authormark 2,3 and Euan Hendry \authormark 1
arxiv-2107-05970.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Justus Bohn \authormark 1,*, Ting Shan Luk \authormark 2,3 and Euan Hendry \authormark 1. When light travels through a medium in which the refractive index is rapidly changing with time, the light will undergo a shift in its frequency. Large frequency shifting effects have recently been reported for transparent conductive oxides. These observations have been interpreted as emerging from temporal changes to the propagation phase in a bulk medium resulting from temporal variations in the refractive index, an effect referred to as temporal refraction.

arxiv-2108-09919.title: Hydrodynamic theory of vorticity-induced spin transport
arxiv-2108-09919.creator: Gen Tatara
arxiv-2108-09919.description: Abstract Electron spin transport in a disordered metal is theoretically studied from the hydrodynamic viewpoint focusing on the role of electron vorticity. The spin-resolved momentum flux density of electrons is calculated taking account of the spin-orbit interaction and uniform magnetization, and the expression for the spin motive force is obtained as the linear response to a driving electric field.

arxiv-2109-09385.title: Flexible User Mapping for Radio Resource Assignment in Advanced Satellite Payloads
arxiv-2109-09385.creator: Tomás Ramírez 1 , Carlos Mosquera 1 , Nader Alagha 2
arxiv-2109-09385.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tomás Ramírez 1 , Carlos Mosquera 1 , Nader Alagha 2. This work explores the flexible assignment of users to beams in order to match the non-uniform traffic demand in satellite systems, breaking the conventional cell boundaries and serving users not necessarily by the corresponding beams yielding more power. The smart beam-user mapping is jointly explored with adjustable bandwidth allocation per beam, and tested against different techniques for payloads with flexible radio resource allocation.

arxiv-2210-01502.title: Bridging Positivity and S-matrix Bootstrap Bounds
arxiv-2210-01502.description: Abstract The main objective of this work is to isolate Effective Field Theory scattering amplitudes in the space of non-perturbative two-to-two amplitudes, using the S-matrix Bootstrap. We do so by introducing the notion of Effective Field Theory cutoff in the S-matrix Bootstrap approach.

arxiv-2210-15107.title: Boosting Point Clouds Rendering via Radiance Mapping
arxiv-2210-15107.creator: Xiaoyang Huang, Yi Zhang, Bingbing Ni, Teng Li, Kai Chen, Wenjun Zhang
arxiv-2210-15107.description: Abstract Recent years we have witnessed rapid development in NeRF-based image rendering due to its high quality. However, point clouds rendering is somehow less explored. Compared to NeRF-based rendering which suffers from dense spatial sampling, point clouds rendering is naturally less computation intensive, which enables its deployment in mobile computing device.

arxiv-2406-17142.title: Continuous drive heterodyne microwave sensing with spin qubits in hexagonal boron nitride
arxiv-2406-17142.creator: Charlie J. Patrickson, Valentin Haemmerli, Shi Guo, Andrew J. Ramsay, Isaac J. Luxmoore
arxiv-2406-17142.description: Abstract Quantum sensors that use solid state spin defects have emerged as effective probes of weak alternating magnetic signals. By recording the phase of a signal relative to an external clock, these devices can resolve signal frequencies to a precision orders of magnitude longer than the spin state lifetime.

arxiv-2410-03977.title: Learning to Balance: Diverse Normalization for Cloth-Changing Person Re-Identification
arxiv-2410-03977.creator: Hongjun Wang, Jiyuan Chen, Zhengwei Yin, Xuan Song, Yinqiang Zheng,
arxiv-2410-03977.description: Abstract Cloth-Changing Person Re-Identification (CC-ReID) involves recognizing individuals in images regardless of clothing status. In this paper, we empirically and experimentally demonstrate that completely eliminating or fully retaining clothing features is detrimental to the task. Existing work, either relying on clothing labels, silhouettes, or other auxiliary data, fundamentally aim to balance the learning of clothing and identity features.

arxiv-2508-15059.title: Correlating Particle Acceleration Rates with Plasma Conditions in Colliding Wind Binaries 2025
arxiv-2508-15059.creator: Gislaine B. Cordeiro; Diego A. Falceta-Gonçalves; Grzegorz Kowal, Vanessa F. Giraldez-Garcia
arxiv-2508-15059.description: Abstract Recent observations have revealed star-forming regions as possible origin sites of very-high-energy (TeV) cosmic rays, not associated with supernova remnants. Colliding-wind binaries (CWBs) are strong X-ray and radio synchrotron emitters and have been proposed as potential accelerators of such particles.

arxiv-2602-11609.creator: Yiming Gao, Zhen Wang, Jefferson Chen, Mark Antkowiak, Mengzhou Hu, JungHo Kong, Dexter Pratt, Jieyuan Liu, Enze Ma, Zhiting Hu, Eric P. Xing

Xing. pmc-10586192.title: Percutaneous closure of giant saphenous vein graft aneurysm
pmc-10586192.creator: Shu Xian Loh, Conor McQuillan, Alaa H Sharabi, Mohaned Egred
pmc-10586192.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundAneurysmal dilatation of saphenous vein grafts used for coronary artery bypass grafting is a rare complication. These aneurysms are often large in calibre and pose a risk of rupture with significant haemorrhage.Case summaryWe describe a case whereby a large saphenous vein graft aneurysm is closed percutaneously using a vascular plug to cease flow and promote thrombosis of the aneurysm whilst reconstructing the occluded native artery to negate ischaemia.ConclusionSaphenous vein graft aneurysms following coronary artery bypass graft are rare and late complications.

pmc-11544771.title: Inhibition of Chk1 with Prexasertib Enhances the Anticancer Activity of Ciclopirox in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Cells
pmc-11544771.creator: Zhu Huang, Wenjing Li, Yan Wu, Bing Cheng, Shile Huang
pmc-11544771.description: Lung cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is the most prevalent lung cancer subtype. Ciclopirox olamine (CPX), an off-patent fungicide, has been identified as a new anticancer agent. Prexasertib (PRE), a Chk1 inhibitor, is in phase 1/2 clinical trials in various tumors.

pmc-12199947.title: Subcapital Femoral Neck Fracture in a Professionally Active Patient Undergoing Palliative Treatment for Endothelial Cell-Derived Epithelioid Haemangioendothelioma (EHE)
pmc-12199947.creator: Paulina Kluszczyk, Aleksandra Tobiasz, Dawid Szumilas, Mateusz Winder, Jacek Pająk, Robert Kwiatkowski, Jerzy Chudek
pmc-12199947.description: Background and Clinical Significance: Femoral neck fracture frequently occurs in the elderly population but may also present in patients diagnosed with primary cancer or bone metastases. A pathological, oligosymptomatic fracture associated with epithelioid haemangioendothelioma (EHE), a rare endothelial cell-derived sarcoma, is uncommon.

pmc-12370940.title: Hybrid pre trained model based feature extraction for enhanced indoor scene classification in federated learning environments
pmc-12370940.creator: Monica Dutta, Deepali Gupta, Vikas Khullar, Sapna Juneja, Roobaea Alroobaea, Pooja Sapra
pmc-12370940.description: Classification of indoor scenes is a crucial task of computer vision. It has widespread applications like smart homes, smart cities, robotics, etc. Primitive classification methods like Support Vector Machines (SVM) and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), provide a compromised performance with complex indoor environments due to light variations, intra-class similarities, and occlusions.

pmc-12552689.title: Harnessing miRNA therapeutics: a novel approach to combat heart and brain infarctions in atherosclerosis
pmc-12552689.creator: Jie Wang, Yinghui Li, Haoxuan Wang, Qian Meng, Peiyu Li, YuQin Wang, Kun Wang, SuMin Yang
pmc-12552689.description: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small non-coding RNAs that regulate gene expression and play critical roles in various cellular processes. Increasing evidence suggests that miRNAs are involved in the development and progression of atherosclerosis, which is the leading cause of myocardial infarction and stroke. These molecules influence key pathological mechanisms, including lipid metabolism, endothelial dysfunction, vascular inflammation, and plaque stability.

pmc-13054537.title: A clinical decision framework for redox-adapted, EMT-high cancers: From ferroptosis resistance to precision therapeutic stratification
pmc-13054537.creator: Moon Nyeo Park, Hyo Jeong Kim, Sohyun Park, Rony Abdi Syahputra, Domenico V Delfino, Seong-Gyu Ko, Bonglee Kim
pmc-13054537.description: Therapeutic resistance in advanced solid tumors increasingly reflects the emergence of adaptive tumor states rather than the absence of actionable molecular targets. Among these, redox adaptation represents a clinically decisive program that integrates ferroptosis resistance, epithelial–mesenchymal transition (EMT)–driven plasticity, metabolic rewiring, immune evasion, and extracellular vesicle–mediated communication.

pmc-13137678.title: The direct cost of amphibian metamorphosis: insights from body weight loss in facultative paedomorphs
pmc-13137678.creator: Mathieu Denoël, Anthony G E Mathiron, Sarah Baouch, Jean-Paul Lena
pmc-13137678.description: BackgroundMetamorphosis is a key event in the life history of many organisms, including amphibians, because it can involve abrupt changes in morphology and habitat. However, metamorphosis can also be bypassed by paedomorphic processes that allow reproduction at the larval stage.

pmc-13296793.title: Analysis of multi-trait evolution across independently evolved cavefish populations reveals shared and independent evolution of suites of traits
pmc-13296793.creator: Stefan Choy, Maya Enriquez, Rianna Ambosie, Aubrey E. Manning, Briley Mullin, Roberto Rodriguez-Morales, Jennah Abdelaziz, Sarah Jacobson, Evan Lloyd, Naresh Padmanaban, Allison Kimmel, Solomia Lapko, Isabel Carino-Bazan, Helena Bilandžija, Alex C. Keene, Erik R. Duboue, Suzanne E. McGaugh, Johanna
pmc-13296793.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Environmental perturbations often lead to the evolution of multiple traits. Determining whether shared genetic factors underlie multi-trait evolution is a central question in evolutionary biology. In the Mexican tetra, Astyanax mexicanus, cave-dwelling populations have repeatedly evolved multiple traits. The repeated evolution of these traits, paired with robust environmental differences between the surface and cave habitats, provide an opportunity to investigate the genetic basis of multi-trait evolution.

pmc-13344274.title: Changes in cardiac morphometry in fetuses with lower urinary tract obstruction
pmc-13344274.creator: Sarah Araji, Betul Yilmaz Furtun, Sara Al‐Haddad, Roopali Donepudi, Magdalena Sanz Cortes, Jessian Munoz, Cara Buskmiller, Brian Burnett, Michael A Belfort, Michael Jochum, Ahmed A Nassr
pmc-13344274.description: ObjectiveFetal lower urinary tract obstruction (LUTO) is associated with significant perinatal morbidity due to oligohydramnios, pulmonary hypoplasia, and progressive renal dysfunction. In addition to these well‐known sequelae, LUTO has been linked to various cardiac abnormalities on prenatal imaging, including cardiomegaly; ventricular hypertrophy; pericardial effusion; and, in some cases, relatively small left‐sided cardiac structures.

pmc-13687193.title: Migration background and diabetes technology use at diagnosis and follow-up in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes: a single-centre study
pmc-13687193.creator: Dagmar Meraner, Marjan Arvandi, Katharina Pajk, Eva Vonmetz, Wilhelm Oberaigner, Veronika Haslwanter, Sibylle Puntscher, Elisabeth Binder, Elisabeth Steichen, Uwe Siebert, Ines Schaffer, Sabine E Hofer, Daniela Schmid
pmc-13687193.description: AimsTo investigate whether migration background is associated with diabetes technology use at diagnosis and during follow-up in children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included children and adolescents aged 4–19 years with type 1 diabetes duration ≥ 1 year.
